# Coal ore

[All items](Items.md) · [Crafting guide](Crafting-Recipes.md) · [Home](Home.md)

[How to obtain](#how-to-obtain) · [Crafting and processing](#crafting-and-processing)

<a href="Item-coal-ore.md" title="Coal ore"><img src="icons/11.png" width="96" height="96" alt="Coal ore"></a>

Black coal pockets in lighter fractured host rock. A finite underground deposit found at **Y 0 to 80**, with the strongest generation preference near **Y 40**. These are world heights, not depth below the surface. Ore replaces stone and does not regenerate after mining.

## At a glance

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Stack size | 64 |
| Required mining tool | Wood pickaxe or better |
| Placement | World block; cannot be placed directly as an inventory item |

## How to obtain

Find this deposit in stone. Mine it with a **wood pickaxe or better**.

Mining yields <a href="Item-coal.md" title="Coal"><img src="icons/17.png" width="40" height="40" alt="Coal"><br>Coal</a> ×1.

## Crafting and processing

There is no registered crafting or processing recipe for this item. Use the acquisition method above.
